basis: Live long-run evidence showed productive invocations can exceed nominal schedule boundaries, and a controlled same-canonical two-wake canary proved an hourly RRULE can self-shift DTSTART and wake again automatically. Production therefore uses rolling provisional rescue plus completion-relative fast reentry instead of fixed quarter rotation.
same_canonical_overlap_assumption: NOT_REQUIRED; NEWEST_VERIFIED_FUTURE_DSTART_WINS AND STALE OCCURRENCES MAY NOT ROLL STATE BACK
fallback_guarantee_target: If the active invocation disappears after provisional arming, retain a bounded future wake at the configured work horizon plus safety margin and scheduler jitter. On normal close, target a fast next wake at close plus the configured final offset.

independent_fast_wake_upgrade.producer: GitHub PR event lane; optional guarded Actions stale-owner producer

measurement.live_run_useful_span: May exceed the normal 600-second planning target; keep measuring continuous evidence rather than forcing artificial closure.
measurement.recovery_gap: Measure from last meaningful predecessor progress to first meaningful replacement-worker progress.
measurement.normal_continuation_gap: Measure actual final-rearm reference to next observed same-canonical wake; do not assume the configured offset equals delivery latency.
measurement.product_slo: Optimize wall-clock useful-work coverage union, not number of nominal turns.
